headline: Foreign exchange reserves fell by €1.25 billion in July, while foreign currency inflows were €988 million. FX reserves at the BNR: about €63 billion in July, close to June level
summary: Foreign exchange reserves at the National Bank of Romania stood at €63.23 billion at the end of July, close to June's level. Reserves fell by €1.25 billion in July, while foreign currency inflows were €988 million.
why: Central bank foreign exchange reserves signal a country's capacity to defend its currency and meet external obligations.

original_headline: Din rezervele valutare au ieşit în iulie 1,25 mld. euro, în timp ce intrările de valută au fost de 988 mil. euro. Rezervele valutare la BNR: circa 63 mld. euro în iulie, aproape de nivelul din iunie
